title: discoveryTarget
summary: Read the route path from a route discovery request URL.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: The route pathname for /path.__smolter-routes, / for /.__smolter-routes, undefined for other URLs, and an Error for protocol-relative or backslash paths.

sections.title: Namespace
sections.body: Pass discoverySuffix for a custom namespace; createRequestHandler does this from its namespace option.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Use it with createRouteDiscovery in hosts other than Node; createRequestHandler handles discovery requests itself.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: The returned path is only matched against the manifest; it never reaches the filesystem or another URL.
